our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects and bringing new ideas to life.Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Apply advanced statistical methods and AI applications to support technology stabilization, yield improvement, and cost optimization across the global process chain- Participate in root cause analysis teams to define sustainable corrective and preventive actions for process deviations- Execute release and delivery decisions for production goods in strict alignment with established quality and production standards- Sustain and optimize high-volume production by leveraging expert know-how on process requirements and process windows in cooperation with unit process engineers- Act as the Front-End representative for the development of silicon power technologies, collaborating closely with development and transfer teams- Drive and manage actions resulting from technology ramp-up activities following the official production releaseYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed- A Master’s or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Data Science, or a comparable technical field- Ideally several years of professional experience in semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on technology development, process, or yield engineering- Advanced skills in statistical data analysis (SPC, DOE) and the application of AI/Machine Learning for process optimization- A structured and analytical mindset with a proven ability to drive complex topics independently from analysis to implementation- Excellent communication and interface skills to collaborate effectively across global production, quality, and development teams- Fluency in English and German (B2-level) is required#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power Job Description:Xaver is a fast-growing FinTech founded by an experienced leadership team that previously built venture-backed companies generating millions in revenue. Operating in a regulated market with over €100 billion in volume, we are backed by leading founders, experienced industry executives, and top international VCs. Our wealth manager operates as a BaFin-supervised financial institution.Most people in Germany do not save enough for retirement, and the current system makes financial planning complex and inaccessible. At Xaver, we are building next-generation digital pension and wealth management solutions to solve this structural challenge. We partner with top-tier insurers, broker networks, and financial institutions that leverage our platform to deliver modern wealth management to their customers.Your Role:As a Senior Backend & Infrastructure Developer , you will play a critical role in engineering the backbone of our platform. You will be responsible for translating complex financial, insurance, and broker workflows into resilient, performant backend services and scalable cloud infrastructure.You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with our CPTO, Product Managers, and Staff Engineers, taking technical ownership of business-critical logic and helping shape architectural decisions across our ecosystem.Our Tech Stack• Language & Frameworks: TypeScript, Nest.js (Next.js on the frontend)• Databases & Caching: MongoDB, Redis• Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Infrastructure as Code (IaC)• CI/CD & Tooling: Bitbucket Pipelines, GitYour Key Responsibilities:• Core Business Logic: Design, build, and optimize backend domain logic handling insurance broker flows, financial calculations, portfolio operations, and consumer-facing pension transactions.• Service Architecture & Inter-Backend Communication: Define and implement robust communication patterns between internal microservices, partner APIs, and asynchronous event streams.• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Own, maintain, and scale our AWS infrastructure, ensuring high availability, observability, and cost-efficiency.• CI/CD & Automation: Evolve our Bitbucket Pipelines to ensure smooth, secure, and automated testing and deployment workflows.• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Staff Engineering, Product Management, and the CPTO to refine product specs, break down complex requirements, and set technical standards.• Security & Compliance: Build secure, auditable, and resilient systems that adhere to the high compliance and data protection standards of a BaFin-regulated financial institution.Your Qualifications:• Extensive Backend Experience: Proven track record in designing and maintaining production-grade backends using TypeScript and Nest.js (or modern Node.js frameworks).• Database & In-Memory Expertise: Deep working knowledge of schema design, indexing, and query optimization in MongoDB , paired with practical caching and queueing patterns using Redis .• Cloud & Infrastructure Fluency: Hands-on experience architecting and managing workloads on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation).• Distributed Systems Mindset: Solid understanding of inter-service communication (REST, gRPC, message brokers/event-driven architectures) and resilience patterns (circuit breakers, retries, distributed tracing).• Domain Problem Solving: Experience translating complex real-world rules (fintech, banking, insurance, or e-commerce) into clear, testable, and maintainable domain code.• Communication & Mindset: Collaborative attitude, pragmatic decision-making, and strong communication skills in English.• Nice to Have: Frontend familiarity with Next.js is a welcome plus, though not a hard requirement.Reporting to:CPTOLocation:KölnWhat We Offer:• High Impact: Direct co-ownership over foundational architecture in a €100B+ market with no legacy constraints.• Direct Access to Leadership: A flat hierarchy where you collaborate daily with Staff Engineers, Product Leads, and the CPTO.• Competitive Compensation: An attractive salary reflecting your senior experience, plus company perks.• Modern Equipment: Latest MacBook Pro (or your choice of hardware) and productivity tooling.• Workplace: Modern office space in central Cologne , with a flexible hybrid work model.• Benefits & Perks:• Urban Sports Club membership subsidy• A Round-the-World flight ticket to celebrate your 4th anniversary with XaverApplication Process:Send us your CV and your GitHub/portfolio link (or code samples/open-source contributions) via the company link. No cover letter, photo, or date of birth required.About usXaver enables Financial Institutions to close Europe’s pension gap. By offering an advanced AI-driven B2B platform for life insurance and private pension sales, Xaver enhances the operational and sales efficiency of banks, insurers, and brokers by up to 65% and introduces a new era of white-labeled private pension products.With a leadership team of experienced industry veterans - Max Bachem, Ole Breulmann Dr. Björn Holste and Nigel Jankelson - and backing from leading VC funds and a prominent group of former financial institution executives, fintech pioneers, and unicorn founders, Xaver is dedicated to improving the pension situation of Europeans through their B2B offering.

Die Universität Paderborn ist eine leistungsstarke und international orientierte Campus-Universität.  In interdisziplinären Teams gestalten wir zukunftsweisende Forschung, innovative Lehre sowie den aktiven Wissenstransfer in die Gesellschaft.  Als wichtige Forschungs- und Kooperationspartnerin prägt die Universität auch regionale Entwicklungsstrategien.  Unseren Beschäftigten in Forschung, Lehre, Technik und Verwaltung bieten wir ein lebendiges, familienfreundliches und chancengerechtes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und vielfältigen Möglichkeiten.  Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft!In der Fakultät für Naturwissenschaften – AG Bartley, Department Physik, Institut für Photonische Quantensysteme – ist zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Stelle alswissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiterin (w/m/d)**(Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L)im Umfang von 100 % der regelmäßigen Arbeitszeit zu besetzen. Es handelt sich um eine zunächst bis zum 31. Januar 2031 wegen Drittmittelfinanzierung im Sinne des Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetzes (WissZeitVG) befristete Tätigkeit. Die Befristungsdauer entspricht dem voraussichtlich bewilligten Projektzeitraum.Projektbeschreibung und Aufgaben:• Design und Simulation neuartiger supraleitender elektrische Schaltkreise in Kombination mit supraleitenden Einzelphotonendetektoren• Tieftemperatur-Charakterisierung supraleitender Schaltkreise und supraleitender Detektoren• Aufbau und Management der benötigten Infrastruktur zur Charakterisierung supraleitender Schaltkreise• Entwicklung und Gestaltung eines Process Design Kits für supraleitende Schaltkreise und supraleitende Detektoren• Aktive Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Projektpartnern• Vorbereitung wiss. Veröffentlichungen, Vorträge und Patentanmeldungen, sowie ggfs. Nachfolgeprojekten und -aktivitätenEinstellungsvoraussetzungen:• Ein überdurchschnittlicher abgeschlossener wissenschaftlicher Hochschulabschluss (Master) sowie eine sehr gut abgeschlossene Promotion sind vorausgesetzt.• Exzellente englisch Kenntnisse in Schrift und Sprache werden erwartet.• Erfahrungen im Bereich der Charakterisierung und dem Design von SNSPDs und den dazugehörigen Kavitäten sind erwünscht.• Kenntnisse über den Aufbau und die Funktionsweise von Josephson Junction basierten Schaltkreisen sind vom Vorteil.• Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Kenntnisse in Cadence, oder vergleichbaren SPICE Simulatoren.• Erfahrungen im Bereich der Charakterisierung von supraleitenden Schaltkreisen sind vom Vorteil.• Vom Vorteil sind Wissen über die Anforderung von photonischen Quantensystemen an Detektorsystemen.• Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Kenntnisse in der Sicherung von Patenten.Wir bieten Ihnen:• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung sowie die individuelle Möglichkeit zur mobilen Arbeit• Vielzahl von Gesundheits-, Beratungs- und Präventionsangeboten• Attraktive Nebenleistungen wie Kinderbetreuungsmöglichkeiten und Sportangebote• Möglichkeit zur internen und externen Fort- und Weiterbildung• Zusätzliche Leistungen nach dem Tarifvertrag der Länder (TV-L) wie Jahressonderzahlung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen sowie die Zusatzversorgung der VBLBewerbungen von Frauen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht und werden gem. Landesgleichstellungsgesetz NRW (LGG) bei gleicher Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung bevorzugt berücksichtigt, sofern nicht in der Person eines Mitbewerbers liegende Gründe überwiegen. Teilzeitbeschäftigung ist grundsätzlich möglich. Ebenso ist die Bewerbung geeigneter Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter im Sinne des Sozialgesetzbuches Neuntes Buch (SGB IX) erwünscht.Bewerbungen mit den üblichen Unterlagen werden unter Angabe der Kennziffer 7459 bis zum 11. Dezember 2026 erbeten an tim.bartley@uni-paderborn.deInformationen zur Verarbeitung Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten finden Sie unter: www.uni-paderborn.de/zv/personaldatenschutz.Prof. Dr. Tim BartleyFakultät für NaturwissenschaftenUniversität PaderbornWarburger Str. 10033098 PaderbornPaderborn University is a high-performance and internationally oriented university. Within interdisciplinary teams, we undertake forward-looking research, design innovative teaching concepts and actively transfer knowledge into society. As an important research and cooperation partner, the university also shapes regional development strategies. We offer our employees in research, teaching, technology and administration a lively, family-friendly and equal opportunity environment, a lean management structure and diverse opportunities. Join us to invent the future!In the Faculty of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematics in the Department of Computer Science – Research Group Computer Architecture – the following position is to be filled as soon as possibleResearch Assistant (f/m/d)(Salary level according to 13 TV-L)with 100 % of the regular working hours. This is a qualification position within the meaning of the German Act on Fixed-Term Research Employment Contracts for Academic Staff (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz “WissZeitVG”), which serves to promote a doctoral procedure. The position is, depending on the qualification achieved to date, initially limited for a period of three years. An extension is generally possible within the time limits of the “WissZeitVG”.The research group, led by Prof. Dr.-Ing. Asif Ali Khan, works at the intersection of emerging computing architectures and compilers, using both conventional and emerging non-volatile memory technologies. Its research areas include in-memory and near-memory computing as well as the development of modeling and simulation frameworks and cost models for these novel systems.
